index.title: The organisations behind the chapter
index.summary: TiE Siliguri is powered by partners who believe in North Bengal's entrepreneurs — sponsors and institutions that give the chapter its venues, its reach and its momentum.
intro: A chapter is only as strong as the ecosystem around it. Our partners provide the spaces, the support and the networks that turn a calendar of events into a genuine community.
We are proud to be backed by leading institutions from across the region.

inspiria.title: INSPIRIA Knowledge Campus
inspiria.summary: One of North Bengal's leading education campuses and a proud Annual Sponsor of TiE Siliguri — and a host venue for the chapter's flagship programmes.
body: Established in 2015, Inspiria Knowledge Campus is a private college in Siliguri built with one aim: to make the region's youth genuinely employable. Affiliated with MAKAUT, NAAC-accredited and AICTE-approved, it spans a green five-acre campus with technology-enabled classrooms, media studios, a digital library and full sports facilities.

Inspiria runs four schools — Management, Computer Science, Design & Media, and Hospitality — offering BBA, BCA, B.Sc. and BHM programmes, with a placement network that includes recruiters like Amazon, Zomato, Raymond and The Leela.
As a chapter partner, Inspiria brings its campus, its students and its belief in enterprise to TiE Siliguri — and hosts chapter programmes including the AI Immersion Residency.

smarthub.title: SmartHub
smarthub.summary: A proud Annual Sponsor of TiE Siliguri, supporting the chapter's mission to grow North Bengal's entrepreneurial ecosystem.
body: SmartHub partners with TiE Siliguri as an Annual Sponsor, standing behind the chapter's work to mentor founders, host learning sessions and connect the region's entrepreneurs to a global network.
Partnerships like this one are what make the chapter's calendar possible — and what turn TiE Siliguri from an idea into an active, growing community.
